# markClipper v1.1.0 — Photo Lab max power

**90+ features.** The Photo Lab turns any page into a harvestable gallery.

## Highlights

### Photos tab (new)

- Grab up to **250 images/page** from `img`, `picture/srcset`, `data-src`, lazy attributes, `og:image` and CSS hero backgrounds
- Hi-res URL resolution (largest srcset candidate), toggleable
- Dedupe by normalized URL · skip icons/avatars · skip data-URLs · min-width slider
- Grid: tap-select, All/None, caption search, 3 sorts, WxH badges, lazy + debounced 60fps
- Lightbox: fullscreen, prev/next, copy Markdown, download, open original, double-click open
- **Gallery clips**: `### Photo N` + image + caption + original — one note for the whole set
- **Bulk download** via `chrome.downloads` · copy gallery Markdown · photo counts in stats

### Screenshot clip

- Visible-tab PNG/JPEG capture
- In-panel preview
- **Downscaled 1100px embed** (storage-quota safe) saved as a self-contained Markdown note
- Original always downloadable

### Single image clip

Right-click any image → clip with caption + source link.

### Settings

Hi-res · skip icons/avatars · skip data-URLs · CSS backgrounds · captions · min width · shot format.

### Keys

`Ctrl+Shift+I` photos · `Ctrl+Shift+P` screenshot (plus all v1.0.0 commands).

## Install

Load unpacked → this folder → pin → click (panel opens). v1.0.0 users: Reload ↻.
